h1: The 5 Best Lawn Mowers Under $150 of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Lawn Mowers Under $150: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 5 budget lawn mowers under $150 scored on cutting width, power source and upkeep, from a motorless reel to a brushless cordless.
summary: The Litheli 14-Inch Cordless is the best all-round budget mower: a brushless motor, a 5.0Ah battery and charger in the box, and five cutting heights. The BLACK+DECKER BESTA512CM wins for tiny yards because it doubles as a trimmer and edger. The LawnMaster MEB1114K is the corded pick for bigger flat lawns, and the American Lawn Mower 1204-14 is the quiet, zero-fuel choice for small, well-kept grass.
intro: Cheap mowers fail in a predictable way: buyers match the cutting width to their lawn and forget the power source. A cordless deck with a small battery quits at the back fence, a corded one tethers you to an outlet on the wrong side of the house, and a reel mower gives up the first time the grass gets ahead of you. The price ceiling does not change those limits, it just hides them.

So we ranked these five by how well each power system fits a real small yard. We reviewed spec sheets and owner feedback for cutting width, motor type, battery or cord arrangement and height adjustment, then scored each on the Primea framework. Two of the five list in the $100 to $200 bracket, so confirm the live price sits under $150 before you buy.

products.name: Litheli 14-Inch Cordless Push Mower with 5.0Ah Battery
products.verdict: The only pick here with a brushless motor, a full battery kit and real height control.
products.description:
The Litheli pairs a 14-inch deck with a brushless motor and ships with its 5.0Ah battery and charger. That last detail matters at this price: many cordless mowers in the bracket sell the deck bare and leave you buying a battery that costs as much as the mower itself.

It ranks first because it removes both of the budget-mower penalties at once. There is no cord to drag across flower beds, and a brushless motor wastes less energy as heat, which stretches a single charge further than a brushed motor on the same cell. The five-position height adjustment also lets you raise the deck for stressed summer grass instead of scalping it.

Buy it for a lawn you can finish in one battery charge. The caveat is the 14-inch width: every extra pass costs time, and the listing gives no runtime figure, so very large yards will want a second battery.
products.idealFor: Owners of a small to medium lawn who want no cord and no fuel.
products.skipIf: Your lawn needs more than one charge or a wide deck.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BESTA512CM 3-in-1 Corded Mower, Trimmer, and Edger
products.verdict: One tool that mows, trims and edges, and the lowest price in this ranking.
products.description:
The BESTA512CM is a 12-inch corded mower driven by a 6.5-amp motor, and it converts into a string trimmer and an edger. For a townhouse or a patio-sized lawn, that replaces three separate tools and the shed space they occupy.

It sits below the Litheli because the motor is the smallest corded rating in the group and the deck is the narrowest of the electric pushes. Against the LawnMaster, you give up 3 inches of width and 4.5 amps of motor to gain the trimmer and edger modes. That is a fair trade on a lawn with fences and flower borders, and a poor one on open turf.

Choose it if your yard is small and fiddly. The honest caveat is conversion time: every swap between mower and trimmer is a few minutes of fiddling, so it suits weekly upkeep better than quick touch-ups.
products.idealFor: Townhouse or patio lawns with beds, fences and edges to tidy.
products.skipIf: You have open turf where deck width saves the most time.

products.name: LawnMaster MEB1114K 15-Inch 11-Amp Corded Mower
products.verdict: The widest deck and the strongest motor in the group, tied to an outlet.
products.description:
LawnMaster's MEB1114K puts an 11-amp corded motor behind a 15-inch deck, the widest cut and the highest amperage of any mower in this ranking. Corded power does not fade as a battery drains, so the last strip of grass gets the same torque as the first.

It lands third because the cord is a real constraint. A cordless pick like the Litheli lets you walk anywhere; the LawnMaster needs an outdoor extension cord and a routine for keeping it behind you. It beats the BLACK+DECKER on raw capability, giving 3 extra inches of width and far more motor, but it lacks that mower's trimmer modes.

Buy it for a flat, rectangular lawn within cord reach of one outlet. It is listed in the $100 to $200 bracket, so verify the live price is under $150, and skip it if you have trees or beds the cord will snag on.
pros: Constant power to the last pass
products.idealFor: Flat, open yards within easy reach of an outdoor outlet.
products.skipIf: Your lawn is cluttered with trees, beds or far from power.

products.name: 13-Inch 40V Cordless Electric Lawn Mower
products.verdict: A light, small-footprint cordless for patios and postage-stamp lawns.
products.description:
This 13-inch mower runs on a 40V battery system and uses a lightweight push design. It is built for small yards and patch lawns, where manoeuvring a heavy deck matters more than width.

It ranks below the Litheli for what the listing leaves out. The Litheli names its brushless motor, 5.0Ah capacity and five height positions; this mower lists only the 40V platform and the 13-inch cut. With less to verify, it is harder to recommend over a mower whose battery kit is spelled out. Against the 12-inch BLACK+DECKER it wins on freedom from the cord.

Buy it for a small, tight lawn where weight is the priority. The caveat is that it is the narrowest cordless here, and the listing does not confirm whether a battery ships in the box, so check the contents before ordering.
products.idealFor: Patio lawns and tight yards where a light mower is easier to handle.
products.skipIf: You want a confirmed brushless motor or a battery kit spelled out.

products.name: American Lawn Mower 1204-14 14-Inch 4-Blade Push Reel Mower
products.verdict: No motor, no battery, no cord, as long as your grass stays short.
products.description:
The 1204-14 is a push reel mower: a 14-inch, four-blade cylinder that spins as the wheels turn and snips grass against a fixed bar. There is no motor, cord or battery to fail, and the cut is clean and quiet.

It ranks last for a physical reason. Reel mowers depend on your effort, so they struggle with tall, wet or weedy growth that a motor simply powers through. The Litheli and LawnMaster do that work for you. Where the reel wins is upkeep: nothing to charge, nothing to refuel, nothing to plug in.

Buy it for a small lawn mowed often, so the blades never face overgrown grass. Skip it if you mow every two weeks or face thick turf, because a reel pushes harder than any motor pick here.
products.idealFor: Small lawns mowed weekly by owners who value quiet and zero upkeep.
products.skipIf: Your grass grows fast, runs tall or you mow irregularly.

methodology.title: Power fit
methodology.description: We judged whether each power source, cordless, corded or manual, suits a small yard without hidden extra costs.

methodology.title: Cutting width
methodology.description: Deck width from 12 to 15 inches sets how many passes a lawn needs, so we weighted it against weight and handling.

methodology.title: Motor and efficiency
methodology.description: We compared motor type and amperage, favouring brushless and higher-amp designs for sustained power.

methodology.title: Height adjustment
methodology.description: Adjustable deck height protects grass in summer stress, so confirmed settings scored higher than unstated ones.

methodology.title: Upkeep and value
methodology.description: Battery included or not, tools replaced and moving parts to maintain all fed into the value score for the price bracket.

whatMatters.factor: Match the power source to the yard
whatMatters.detail: Cordless suits irregular lawns, corded suits flat rectangles near an outlet, and a reel suits tiny lawns cut weekly. The wrong choice costs more than the mower. Count how far the farthest corner sits from an outdoor outlet before you compare anything else on a listing.

whatMatters.factor: Is the battery in the box?
whatMatters.detail: A cordless deck sold without its battery and charger can cost nearly as much again to make usable. The Litheli lists its 5.0Ah battery and charger as included. On any cordless listing, scan the title and bullets for the word included before you trust the headline price.

Brushless motors switch current electronically instead of through contact brushes, so they run cooler and stretch a battery further on the same lawn. Check the listing for the word brushless. If a cordless mower does not say, assume a standard brushed motor.

Each extra inch of deck trims passes, but wider decks are heavier and harder to turn in tight beds. Across this 12 to 15 inch range, the widest deck saves a visible number of passes on a large rectangle. Measure your yard before choosing, and weigh width against storage space.

Cutting grass too short in summer heat browns it and invites weeds. A multi-position height lever lets you raise the deck as seasons change. The Litheli names five positions. If a listing never mentions height settings, look for a lever diagram in the product photos.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A deck between 12 and 15 inches, a power source that matches your outlet access, and height settings you can change without tools.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The Litheli 14-Inch Cordless covers all three. For a yard of beds and borders, the BLACK+DECKER BESTA512CM adds trimmer and edger modes.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: Your lawn needs more than one battery charge, has slopes, or has thick grass. At that point a wider self-propelled mower beats any pick in this price bracket.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: The lawn is small and mown often. The American Lawn Mower 1204-14 or the BLACK+DECKER BESTA512CM do the job for the least money.

faq.q: Does the Litheli battery work with other tools?
faq.a: The listing does not name a shared battery platform, so assume the 5.0Ah pack is tied to this mower. Check the battery plug and voltage in the product photos against any other Litheli tool before buying a second pack for cross-use.

faq.q: What extension cord do corded mowers need?
faq.a: The LawnMaster MEB1114K draws 11 amps, so use an outdoor-rated cord with a heavy enough gauge for its length. The lighter 6.5-amp BLACK+DECKER BESTA512CM is more forgiving, but a thin indoor cord is still a mistake on either.

faq.q: Is a reel mower worth it over the cordless picks?
faq.a: Only if your lawn is small and cut weekly. The American Lawn Mower 1204-14 has no motor to maintain, but it needs real effort and struggles with tall grass, where the Litheli simply powers through.

faq.q: How do I set up the BLACK+DECKER conversions?
faq.a: The BESTA512CM converts between mower, trimmer and edger by swapping the head and handle configuration. Read the manual once before the first conversion, since the swap order matters and rushing it risks cross-threading the plastic fittings.

faq.q: How should I store a cordless mower over winter?
faq.a: Remove the battery from the Litheli or the 40V mower and keep it indoors at moderate temperature, partly charged. Leaving a lithium pack fully drained in a cold shed shortens its life more than any use does.

faq.q: Can these mowers handle a sloped or bumpy lawn?
faq.a: Light 13 to 15-inch decks like the 40V cordless and LawnMaster manage gentle slopes, but none here is self-propelled. On a steep slope, push up and down rather than across and expect the reel mower to be the hardest work.

finalTake: For most small yards the Litheli 14-Inch Cordless is the answer: brushless motor, battery and charger in the box, and five cutting heights. If your lawn is a patch with borders, the BLACK+DECKER BESTA512CM does three jobs for the lowest price. For flat open grass beside an outlet, the LawnMaster MEB1114K adds the widest deck. And for a tiny, well-kept lawn, the American Lawn Mower 1204-14 needs nothing but a push.
